ShortDescription.Value: Manage your city treasury: safety net top ups, on demand cash, and a gentle budget autopilot.

LongDescription.Value: City Treasury manages in game money three ways. A safety net keeps the treasury above a floor you set. Cash control adds a chosen amount or sets an exact balance from the options page. A budget autopilot watches the monthly trend and nudges taxes in small capped steps when deficits or surpluses persist.
